title: Real-Time Collaboration Dashboard
description: A modern full-stack collaboration platform with real-time messaging and synchronization capabilities. Features include one-to-one and group chat with typing indicators, live data sync, secure authentication with Clerk, admin-controlled group management, and dark/light theme support.

title: Weather App
description: A modern weather application built with React that provides real-time weather information. Features include location-based weather, 7-day forecasts, and responsive design with smooth animations.

title: Restaurant Design
description: A sophisticated restaurant website with modern UI/UX design. Features include menu display, online ordering system, and elegant animations inspired by professional Figma templates.

title: Bishnu Avatar
description: An interactive avatar customization application built with React. Users can create and customize digital avatars with various features and styling options.

title: Tripease - Travel & Tourism
description: A comprehensive MERN stack travel and tourism website with integrated booking systems, payment gateways, and user authentication. Features include tour packages, booking management, and admin dashboard.

title: Pokédex Application
description: A feature-rich Pokédex application that fetches and displays Pokémon data from external APIs. Includes search functionality, detailed Pokémon information, and modern UI with smooth animations.

title: Drag & Drop Builder
description: A powerful drag-and-drop UI builder that allows users to create custom layouts by dragging elements from a sidebar into a workspace. Features include real-time preview and component customization.
